cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Name Your Backers
cards.instruction: Get someone to reveal who supports their position, who authorized it, and who benefits from it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Before I tell the workshop staff they're closing, who backed your decision?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The director approved it. Please just send the notice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I'll name her approval. Who else supported it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sales. They're getting the floor space, but leave them out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then Sales can join the staff meeting. Who signed off on giving them our space?

mechanism: A professionally separates approver, supporters and beneficiaries to force full disclosure of who stands behind workshop closure.
confusable: D54 finds who can decide; D64 also exposes supporters and beneficiaries behind a position, not just final power.
comparison: Roof alternative documents funding beneficiary; workshop alternative brings the beneficiary into staff scrutiny of closure.
seedUse: Workshop closure, director approval and Sales floor-space gain derive from D64-a; S03 adds exact disclosure categories.
